We also design a judge J to manage and monitor the whole debate process. The judge contains two different modes: (a) Discriminative Mode, in which the judge J decides whether the correct solution can be obtained after all the debaters finish their arguments in the current iteration; (b) Extractive Mode, in which the judge J needs to extract the final solution based on the whole debate history.
